decisions.numericAudit: String of a lexically resolved catch binding is diagnostic text. Non-catch String conversions, Number conversions and numeric expressions still require a declared kind; shadowed String is never exempt.
decisions.dependencyOrder: Issuer epoch must not exceed dependent epoch. Equal epochs require two signed claims from one native Root actor and the original explicit restsOn dependency; one atomic act replaces separate sequential admissions.
decisions.receiveNext: Declare the place, document and digest which the existing refusal callers already carry; next retains those exact values.
decisions.installedPort: Default to the compiled current receiving adapter on a clean checkout; an explicit installed-port override remains available.
decisions.worldStanding: Exact expected physical bytes follow the selected published standing: 45384, with the same 1048576 limit.
decisions.mcpVector: Replay the exact pinned 0.1.3 producer using current provider forms; no pin or provider implementation changes.
